text:
ira: Heads-up — we're seeing ~10% 502s to model-api (eu-west-1) over the last 7m. Correlates to traffic from a small set of client IPs behind our partner proxy.

sam: saw alert. any pattern in the ALB logs?

ira: ALB logs show TLS handshake failures. Notably a chunk of connections have empty SNI/server_name. Snippet: 

```
2026-03-18T12:34:45Z app/my-alb 10.0.1.23:443 10.0.2.45:54212 0.001 0.000 0.000 TLS_HANDSHAKE_ERROR "-" "-" "-" sni:-
```

ira: Also ran a quick tcpdump on one target, we see raw TLS client_hello with no server_name in some flows.

maria: hmm. Partner proxy does TLS passthrough for certain client types. If the proxy terminates TLS and re-initiates, it should set SNI, but if it does CONNECT or TCP relay it might drop SNI or rewrite it.

sam: what does our ingress expect? nginx-ingress picks certs by host header when ALB terminates TLS, but for passthrough it relies on ssl_preread to inspect SNI. If SNI is missing we fall back to default cert -> hostname mismatch -> backend rejects or returns 502.

ira: confirmed: in eu-west we recently added a tcp listener rule for legacy partner traffic that forwards at L4 to the nodes (target group with protocol TLS). That path bypasses ALB TLS-termination, so ingress must handle SNI. We don't have a generic fallback cert for that host.

maria: quick mitigation options: 1) force ALB to terminate TLS for that IP range (easy) but that breaks mTLS clients who require end-to-end TLS. 2) have ingress use a generic wildcard cert for the passthrough path (works but weaker trust). 3) ask partner to preserve SNI (longer term).

sam: for canary: change ALB listener for one AZ to TLS-terminate for a small CIDR block and monitor. That avoids touching mTLS everywhere.

ira: starting canary — updating listener in eu-west-1a to HTTPS terminate and attach wildcard cert for model-api.canary. I'll limit to partner CIDR /28.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1345 created; severity: S2; assigned: eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: Applied listener change to eu-west-1a (canary id: canary-18765).

leo: canary metrics after 8m: error-rate for that CIDR dropped from 9.8% -> 0.6%. Latency unchanged. Looks promising.

maria: nice. Next: add ingress ssl_preread mapping for SNI routes so passthrough works if partner can't set SNI. nginx has `map $ssl_preread_server_name $upstream_host` usage. We'll draft a helm patch.

sam: also audit other ALB listeners — there may be more accidental L4 forwards created during last network change. I have a list of suspected listeners and will sweep.

ira: long-term we should document expected behavior for partners (must pass SNI) and add validation to onboarding checklist. For now I'll expand canary to eu-west-1b after we confirm no mTLS regressions. :thumbsup:

leo: +1 — will coordinate rollout and watch for mTLS client failures.
